title: Retail Fill Still Running When a Member Moves to Home Delivery: Quantity Added to a Member-Filed Exception Request
content:
A member who opened the Home Delivery Pharmacy account within the last 90 days is moving from retail, and under the Utilization Management Program the retail fill still running is added to the quantity a member-filed first-time quantity limit exception request asks for, so that the first home delivery fill does not reject inside the same rolling 30 days. The retail fill read is the member's most recent paid retail fill of the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.

**Rule.**

1. When the home delivery account was opened within the last 90 days and the most recent paid retail fill of the drug was dispensed **at least 7 days** before the filing date and its days supply has not yet run out, the unused part of that fill is added, being its quantity times the days of its supply still remaining divided by its days supply.
2. When the home delivery account was opened within the last 90 days and that fill was dispensed **fewer than 7 days** before the filing date, its whole quantity is added.
3. When the account was opened earlier than 90 days before, or the retail fill's days supply has already run out, nothing is added; nothing is added either for a member with no Home Delivery Pharmacy account.

Days are counted from the date in question to the filing date: an account opened 90 days before the filing date was opened within the last 90 days; one opened 91 days before was not. The days of supply still remaining are the fill's days supply less the days since it was dispensed, and the supply has run out once those days reach the days supply.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; account opened 40 days before filing; retail fill of 9 tablets for 30 days)

| Days since the retail fill was dispensed | Supply status | Quantity added |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | running | 9 (whole fill) |
| 7 | running, 23 days remain | 9 times 23 divided by 30: 6.9 |
| 12 | running, 18 days remain | 9 times 18 divided by 30: 5.4 |
| 30 | run out | nothing |

With the same fill but an account opened 91 days before filing, nothing is added whatever the age of the fill.
